description: Create a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX document from a structured spec and save it as a private file in your Besidka library. Besidka renders the file itself: no API key of yours is used and nothing is sent to an AI provider. The file counts against your storage quota and expires like an upload. Find it later with list_files (source assistant). Limits: the serialized spec is at most 200000 characters, a pdf or docx at most 200 pages, a pptx at most 60 slides, an xlsx at most 100000 cells and the file at most 20 MB, at most 10 documents a minute and 100 a day. Images only by the `fileId` of a PNG or JPEG file already in your library (find ids with list_files), at most 20, never URLs or data URIs. If you wrote the content with an AI model, set `aiGenerated` to true so the file is marked as AI-generated; otherwise it is marked only as created by a connected app. Pass `spec` as a JSON object, not a string: the `format` and `title` fields are filled from the top-level arguments, and `specVersion` defaults to 1. A request is at most 512 KiB, so Cyrillic text fits the whole character limit while CJK text above about 170000 characters does not. Text is plain: no HTML or Markdown inside it, no control characters; use runs for bold, italic, underline, code and links (https: or mailto: only). Write in the language of the content and set `language` as a BCP 47 tag such as "en" or "uk". Optional `theme`: {"font"?:"sans"|"serif","accent"?: "neutral"|"blue"|"green"|"orange"|"violet"}; both fields are optional and a missing one falls back to "sans" or "neutral". Blocks for pdf and docx: {"type":"heading","level":1-4,"text"}, {"type":"paragraph","runs":[...],"align?"}, {"type":"list","ordered":bool,"items":[{"runs":[...],"children?":[...]}]} (three levels at most), {"type":"table","header":bool,"columns":[{"text","align?"}],"rows":[[runs,...]]} (every row has one runs array per column), {"type":"image","fileId","alt","widthPercent":10-100}, {"type":"quote","runs"}, {"type":"code","text","language?"}, {"type":"pageBreak"}. A run is {"text","bold?","italic?","underline?","code?","link?":{"href"}}. pdf needs pageSize "A4" or "Letter" and blocks. docx needs blocks. pptx needs aspect "16:9" or "4:3" and slides. Slide layouts: title, title-content, section, two-column (needs columns: two block arrays) and image (needs image {fileId, alt}); at most 12 bullets (each a runs array) per slide, 60 slides, optional notes. xlsx needs sheets {name, columns:[{header, type}], rows}. Column types: string, number, integer, currency, percent, date, boolean. A cell is a string, number, boolean, null, {"date":"2026-11-08"} or {"formula":"SUM(B2:B9)"}: A1 references to the sheet itself (row 1 is the header), plain functions such as SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, ROUND, IF, VLOOKUP, no external references. A row may be shorter than the columns. Sheet names: at most 31 characters, unique, none of [ ] : * ? / \, not "History". Examples of the full document (spec is the object without format and title): pdf: {"specVersion":1,"format":"pdf","title":"Trip plan","language":"en","pageSize":"A4","blocks":[{"type":"heading","level":1,"text":"Trip plan"},{"type":"paragraph","runs":[{"text":"Leave on "},{"text":"Friday","bold":true}]}]} docx: {"specVersion":1,"format":"docx","title":"Cover letter","blocks":[{"type":"paragraph","runs":[{"text":"Dear team,"}]},{"type":"list","ordered":false,"items":[{"runs":[{"text":"Experience"}]}]}]} pptx: {"specVersion":1,"format":"pptx","title":"Q3 review","aspect":"16:9","slides":[{"layout":"title","title":"Q3 review","subtitle":"Sales"},{"layout":"title-content","title":"Highlights","bullets":[[{"text":"Revenue up 12%"}]],"notes":"Thank the team"}]} xlsx: {"specVersion":1,"format":"xlsx","title":"Budget","sheets":[{"name":"Budget","freezeHeader":true,"columns":[{"header":"Item","type":"string"},{"header":"Cost","type":"currency"}],"rows":[["Rent",1200],["Food",400],["Total",{"formula":"SUM(B2:B3)"}]]}]} On an invalid spec the error lists up to 10 `path: message` lines; fix them and call again. Requires signing in (files:write).

aiGenerated.description: Set true when an AI model wrote the content, so the file is marked as AI-generated

fileName.description: File name, for example report.pdf. Defaults to the title

format.description: pdf and docx take blocks, pptx takes slides, xlsx takes sheets

spec.description: Besidka document spec v1 as a JSON object without format and title: blocks (pdf, docx), slides (pptx) or sheets (xlsx), see the tool description for the shapes

title.description: The document title, up to 200 characters

name: create_document
title: Create a document
